packs.name: AI Intelligence
packs.acceptance: Implement one typed tool invocation with synthetic input, explicit authorization and bounded execution; test invalid output, timeout and refusal.

packs.name: Context Engineering
packs.acceptance: Pin documentation references; maintain a non-sensitive task checkpoint, verify recovery in a fresh workspace; never upload private context to external services without approval.

packs.name: Cinematic GPU
packs.acceptance: Render a deterministic scene, test reduced motion and GPU fallback, verify encoding and commercial licensing; keep large output outside Git.

packs.name: Enterprise Development
packs.acceptance: Build a minimal vertical slice with typed API, authentication, RBAC, synthetic data, RTL and isolated deployment tests.

packs.name: Browser Intelligence
packs.acceptance: Run a local synthetic page with isolated browser profile; verify MCP host discovery separately, navigation, screenshots and console diagnostics; disallow authenticated production profiles.

packs.name: DevSecOps
packs.acceptance: Generate SBOM, scan a test fixture and dependencies, validate secret redaction, enforce exact release targets; run only authorized security checks.

packs.name: Agent Evaluation
packs.acceptance: Compare identical synthetic tasks across authorized hosts, record model version, time, functional tests, cost and unavailable metrics; do not claim host parity from local protocol tests.

packs.name: Digital Twin
packs.acceptance: Load a synthetic asset with scene metadata, selectable risk overlays and accessible fallback; benchmark a target device and verify data provenance.

packs.name: Database Intelligence
packs.acceptance: Validate schema and query plans in a disposable database, run tenant isolation and RLS negative tests, verify rollback; no production mutations.

packs.name: Engineering Recovery
packs.acceptance: Use existing hub checkpoint and orchestration tools, verify a clean-session restore from a pinned revision and checksums; store private bundles in approved private storage.
